versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Food Recall Radar.
- Build and manage a personal pantry inventory (brands, products, UPCs, lots) locally.
- Match your pantry against openFDA's live food-recall database using fuzzy matching and lot code extraction.
- Output a risk-ranked action list (check / discard / return) for items affected by Class I/II/III recalls.
- Supports offline operation with recall data caching and full command-line usage for adding, auditing, and reporting.
- Prioritizes ease-of-use, privacy (local storage), and actionable recall alerts.
